diagnosis.original_evidence: GOAL queue-node selection precedes D3DXSprite Begin in a supported path; BeginDest resets StageBoundaryReady so the first otherwise-homogeneous queued GOAL Draw cannot enter the prior eager Flush guard. Source commit c30a67f corrects that boundary.
source_trace: Original GOAL result-progress and two time helper producers create source-owned ScreenHud sprite submissions.
VRProjectedD3DXSpriteIsolationR64 transitions from selected queue node through tracked D3DX Begin/Draw and permits eager original-owner Flush only for proven homogeneous producer.
R84 game stereo renderer and x64 host consume submitted D3D9 GPU draws; the original source scope must survive until actual Draw/Flush, not merely until the caller returns.
diagnosis.root_cause: Late D3DX Begin clears the queue boundary established before Begin; without a first-draw rearm, GOAL progress and glyph draws can be delayed until End or an unrelated semantic producer, losing exact GOAL source ownership.
alternatives_rejected: Do not globally force ID3DXSprite::Flush on every Draw, broaden GOAL admission to generic ScreenHud or stage +TIME, suppress original effects, or infer native eye correctness from a static semantic predicate.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: Material source SHA c30a67fba979b4f53ada99e7b31f9e6b12a501f8 updates queue enter/prequeue GOAL handling, exact first-draw rearm with matching original source in render_semantics.hpp, and dedicated source-mutation regression cases.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Material commit adds specific destructive mutation cases for late GOAL Begin, old-direct-source queue transition and GOAL eager Flush gating. Full exact-SHA CI was blocked before changed-area checks by missing run record; gate remains pending.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Only original tagged GOAL data may enter the exact ScreenHud D3DX batch; R84 and OpenXR host per-eye composition must still pass full CI and later headset acceptance.
